name: Motor Breath #15 Deli
description:
Lineage: Chemdawg x SFV OG

Type: Hybrid

Terpenes: Limonene, ß-Caryophyllene, Myrcene

Effects: Relaxed, Euphoric, Tingly

Rev up your evening with this high-octane hybrid that'll have your engine purring. Motor Breath roars with intense diesel aromatics, dropping hints of garlic and earth in its wake. Pro Gro's master growers have precision-tuned this powerhouse to deliver deep physical relaxation that'll have you feeling like you're floating on cloud nine. Warning: may cause excessive couch-lock and midnight snack raids.
